name: IN-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Marlin Stutzman renominated and running
Prediction markets price Democratic chances near 4%
model.rationale: The district's R+16 lean, Stutzman's incumbency, and his roughly six-to-one fundraising advantage over Kelly Thompson all point to a comfortable Republican hold, and Polymarket prices a Democratic win at only about 4%. With no polls or expert ratings to suggest otherwise, the forecast stays near the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any late-breaking scandal or unexpected outside spending surge could narrow the margin, though a Democratic win remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northeast Indiana's third district is firmly Republican territory, with a partisan lean of about sixteen points toward the GOP. Incumbent Marlin Stutzman was renominated and returns for another term with the advantages of incumbency and a well-funded campaign. He has raised roughly $840,000 and holds about $102,000 on hand, supplemented by modest outside support, while Democrat Kelly Thompson has raised about $136,000 with only $6,000 remaining.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so expectations rest on district fundamentals and money. Prediction markets give Thompson only a small chance of an upset. The realistic range runs from a comfortable Stutzman win to a landslide, with the seat staying safely in Republican hands.
